title: Polynomial identities, sums of three squares, and quaternionic (anti-)automorphisms
description: Paper and Lean 4 formalization (91 theorems, four files): word-indexed polynomial identities expressing (t^2+u^2)^{2m}(x^2+y^2+z^2)^n as a sum of three squares; exact census with generating function (1+s)/(1-s-q-3sq); injectivity via Swierczkowski's freeness theorem; freeness of the rank-three coordinate-axis rotation group at arccos(1/3).
